name: Counter.dev Free Web Analytics
free_limit: Free hosted privacy-focused web analytics with voluntary pay-when-ready donations and no published usage quota; AGPL-3.0 self-hosted version is also available.
watch_out: Hosted service is donation-supported and may change terms; no published usage SLA. Official self-hosted variant is beta, needs Redis and server resources, and lacks archival functionality. Hosted credit-card and commercial terms need confirmation; AGPL obligations apply to self-hosting.
